messages:
Ashwin: Hey team — final loop for Marta G landed for Tue 3:00pm PT. Need panel coverage + someone to own debrief notes. Quick Q: how are we weighting the rubric this round — system design vs infra? leaning 60/40 or 50/50?
Priya: I can do scheduling and send invites. Current volunteers? also we should decide on scribe and debrief length (30m?)
Lina: I can take system design + scribe if that helps. For weighting I'd prefer 55/45 system design -> infra, with a short behavioral check as tie-breaker.
Samir: I can cover infra. Please drop the take-home PR link in the thread so I can skim beforehand. 30m debrief sounds right — we need time to normalize scores.
Ashwin: Thanks. PR is in the candidate folder: https://git.internal/recruiting/marta-takehome (TL;DR is a small infra migration).
recruiter-bot: Interview booked: Marta G — Tue 2025-06-10 15:00 PT — Zoom link https://zoom.company/j/123456789 — calendar invite sent to panel.
Maya: heads up I'm OOO that afternoon — can we shift to 4pm PT or swap folks? @Priya can you check backfill?
Priya: OK checking now. Lina — can you slide to 4pm if needed? otherwise I can ask recruiting for backup. Debrief set to 30m after the loop, scribe = Lina (tentative).
Lina: I can move to 4pm if it helps. If we move, please update invite and note in the description that scribe is Lina and debrief is 30m.
Ashwin: Rubric note for everyone: please score 1-5 on these buckets: system_design, infra, communication. Add a short "impact/tradeoffs" bullet for system_design. Also include a confidence level (low/med/high).
Samir: adding a quick eval template here for copy/paste:
```
system_design: 1-5
infra: 1-5
communication: 1-5
impact_notes: short bullet
confidence: low/med/high
recommend: yes/no
```
Priya: copied into the invite body + the recruiting tracker. Reminder: submit your eval within 24h after the loop — recruiting needs timely feedback. :calendar:
Lina: I'll scribe and start the doc during the call. Ping me 10m before to confirm recording.
Ashwin: Great — thanks everyone. Tagging @recruiting for final confirmation on time/debrief window. :thumbsup:
recruiter-bot: Confirmed with recruiting: 4pm PT works, debrief window reserved 30m immediately after. Candidate materials + scoring sheet: https://recruiting.internal/candidates/marta_g/eval
Priya: Invite updated to 4pm PT and debrief attached. Closing the loop here — please ack in thread when you see the updated calendar.
Samir: Ack.
Lina: Ack.
Maya: Ack (thanks for the swap).
Ashwin: Ack — leaving a quick note in the candidate doc about scoring preference.
